description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
One block per DP row: causal softmax computes prefix min of W; heads: prefix-min, left-neighbour, match; no LayerNorm; 9 blocks, d=30, ff=5.
Simplified recurrence W <- min(W+1, min_{x<l}W - match): drops the own-prefix head and one neuron; 2 heads, 9 blocks, d=26, ff=3.
Sensitivity: TwoHeadDP with soft-min sharpness BETA=5 instead of 30.
Separate sharpness for the match head (GAMMA=30) from the soft-min (BETA=5), to locate what failed at BETA=5.
Sensitivity: soft-min sharpness BETA=2 with GAMMA=30; how soft can the min be before rounding at the read-out fails?
W_o subtracts the match from the left-min into one register, so the MLP needs only 2 neurons; BETA=10, GAMMA=30, d=26.
d=10: positions as (1,x,x^2) with a quadratic peak selecting a_row, ring letters, rank-1 G^(x-t) self-exclusion, 'a' tokens kept out by W=100; 9 blocks, 2 heads, ff=2.
All 9 blocks share one recurrent cell; a row counter (i, i^2) in every token steers the quadratic peak along a; d=12, 2 heads, ff=3.
Strictly causal attention mask (diagonal removed) replaces the self-exclusion code; shared cell, d=10, 2 heads, ff=3.
Each token counts down Y=x-i with Y^2 kept by one neuron; the token at Y=0 is a_i and ',' frozen at Y=0 is the sentinel; shared cell, d=8, 2 heads, ff=4.
Constant and comma flag merged into one register E; ',' takes its sentinel score from a frozen negative Y^2; rectangular attention (2 heads of 3 dims); shared cell, d=7, ff=4.
Margin sweep on SevenRegisters_d7: BETA=5.
Margin sweep on SevenRegisters_d7: BETA=3.5.
No sqrt(dh) score normaliser; match scores recentred to +/-TAU around ',' at 0, so every weight is a small integer (BETA=8, TAU=16, PEAK=64).
Block is x + mlp(x + attn(x)): attention output is scratch, so R needs no clearing and the MLP has 3 neurons; shared cell, d=7, integer weights.
Same weights as TransientAttn_ff3; adds an exhaustive grading run over all 131k string pairs from alphabets ab and ac.
All sharpness constants halved and FAR cut to 32 (BETA=4, TAU=8, PEAK=32), graded with the exhaustive two-letter check.
Margin sweep from Halved_b4_t8_p32_f32: TAU=4.
Margin sweep from Halved_b4_t8_p32_f32: TAU=2.
Margin sweep from Halved_b4_t8_p32_f32: PEAK=12; an unselected neighbour matching a letter then scores TAU-PEAK=-4 against 0 for ','.
Margin sweep: PEAK=6 is below TAU, so a neighbouring token that matches the letter outscores ','; predicted to fail.
Margin sweep from Halved_b4_t8_p32_f32: FAR=16.
Margin sweep from Halved_b4_t8_p32_f32: FAR=10.
Margin sweep from Halved_b4_t8_p32_f32: FAR=4, below the largest W held by ','; predicted to fail.
Control: FAR=16 with only 8 applications of the cell, dropping the final read-out pass; predicted to fail because '=' then lags one row.
Control: 12 applications of the cell, testing whether the answer at '=' is a fixed point after pass 9. It is not: the prediction that it would be was wrong.
Control: pre-attention LayerNorm restored (identity gain), testing whether removing it was necessary; predicted to fail.
Control: standard causal mask, so each token sees itself in the min; tests whether the strict mask is necessary; predicted to fail.
Strict mask back; digit logits offset by +1 so non-digit head rows can be all zero, removing the HIDE constant; shared cell, d=7, ff=3, FAR=16.
Each head returns one scalar value, shrinking W_v and W_o from 7x6 to 7x2; shared cell, d=7, ff=3.
Softmax replaced by hard argmax attention with ties shared evenly: exact integer arithmetic with BETA=TAU=1, PEAK=4; departs from standard softmax attention.
Hard attention with CLEAR=14, just enough for the 'a' tokens; the Y^2 neuron now clips on later tokens, testing whether that is harmless.
Back to softmax attention with CLEAR=14: margin sweep at BETA=3, TAU=8, PEAK=32. NOT a clean pass: 200/200 on the official sample hides real errors (4992/5000 random; 65310/65536 ab; 65308/65536 ac).
Margin sweep at BETA=3.5, TAU=8, PEAK=32, graded by the exhaustive check because BETA=3 failed it while scoring 200/200 on the official sample.
Margin sweep at TAU=3 with a comfortable BETA=8, locating the match-head boundary between TAU=2 (fail) and TAU=4 (pass).
Hard attention at tight constants: PEAK=2 (just above TAU=1) and FAR=9 (just above the largest column value).
Softmax attention with all constants set together near their boundaries: BETA=6, TAU=6, PEAK=12, FAR=12.
Final hard-attention candidate: exact integer registers, BETA=TAU=1, PEAK=2, FAR=9, CLEAR=14; shared cell, d=7, ff=3; 200k random-pair stress check plus exhaustive two-letter check.

Final softmax candidate with margins from the sweeps: BETA=8, TAU=8, PEAK=32, FAR=16, CLEAR=14; one shared cell applied 9 times, d=7, 2 heads, 3 ReLUs; 200k random-pair stress check plus exhaustive two-letter check.
